build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a new PHYRE task function with the creator library
create_scene_objects_with_C_add: create static bars and dynamic objects in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position setters
position_objects_with_setters: position scene objects using set_bottom, set_left, set_right, set_center_x, and set_angle methods
define_task_goal_with_update_task: define the task objective by calling C.update_task with body1, body2, and a list of spatial relationships
use_spatial_relationship_touching: set the TOUCHING spatial relationship between two bodies to create a touching goal in the PHYRE task
